posts.trend: Commute Times on Bengaluru’s SH-35 Corridor Surge 22% in Two Years, New Mobility Study Reveals
posts.context: The modern Indian urban commute has turned 'five minutes away' into a permanent geographical state.
posts.angle: Navigation apps tell us we are moving when we have actually integrated into the local ecosystem of the crossing.
slides: Haan bhai, Sarjapur signal pe hoon. Bas panch minute.

Nahi, map red nahi dikha raha.
Haan, auto wala cancel kar diya.
Nahi, paidal nahi chal sakta, rasta hi gayab hai.

You have been at the same crossing since 2024.

You live there now.
posts.caption: We all know someone who has been 'reaching in 5 mins' for the last forty minutes. 🗺️
